scope: Initial F01 through F12 control and fault workers. The startup budget covers the process launch and PHP handshake. The existing execution budget begins after that handshake.
reason: An isolated worker occasionally exhausted the prior combined deadline before its handshake. A startup timeout is reported independently and still fails the required run.
acceptance: Every fixed healthy control must complete and every required fault must produce its fixed signal. Startup timeout, execution timeout, an arbitrary crash or unexecuted validation remain failures.
